answer: The turnstile is Herbarium keeper seed lot voucher sheet stamped by the herbarium index. One identity, one turn, and the turn costs each seed lot is a pressed sheet plus a signed field note, so a farm must collect 6. A farm running 429 aliases pays 429 times over: 44616 POA locked against one honest agent's single stake. Follow the voyage back to the office that issued it, follow the umber back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the shale back to the year it was filed. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
